purpose: Six folded-paper creature references, moderate detail and mischievous neutral faces. Runtime is native vector parts, not these PNGs.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A refined Chinese folk CUT-PAPER game creature design sheet, six enemies in a 3 columns by 2 rows grid on warm rice paper. Match an elegant Chinese paper-cut fox game with layered mineral-colored paper, crisp silhouette, ivory negative-space cutwork, hard paper folds, small antique gold crease lines. Medium-low detail, 5 flat colors maximum per creature, 2-3 bold cutwork motifs each. Distinct shapes readable at 55px. These are mischievous shan-hai paper spirits: alert curious small eyes, slightly impish, neither adorable baby mascots nor frightening monsters. NO blush, NO bean-like puffy round bodies, NO huge anime eyes, NO smiling emoji faces, NO teeth, NO angry eyebrows, NO dense ornate filigree, NO photographic grain, NO realistic 3D. Top row SEA: (1) folded jade-and-cinnabar carp demon, angular fan tail, diamond-cut scales and flowing single paper fin; (2) teal and ivory hanging paper-lantern jelly spirit, scalloped folded parasol cap, three angular ribbon tentacles with wave cutouts, tiny neutral eyes; (3) vermilion coral paper crab, cut-fan shell, folded asymmetric claws, jade legs, ivory cloud openings. Bottom row CELESTIAL: (4) indigo and ivory paper manta with swept diamond-fold wings, a few constellation cutouts and one long folded tail; (5) antique gold and indigo hollow hanging ritual bell spirit, three cloud-shaped negative openings, a short cinnabar paper tassel, discreet eyes inside the bell opening; (6) traditional Chinese swallow kite spirit with geometric folded wings, cinnabar ivory indigo panels, long split paper ribbon tail and small gold eye cutouts. Characters are aesthetically related to Chinese landscape paper art, handcrafted and graphic, not toy mascots. No labels, no writing, no interface.
